I haven't made this fix. A marimo-pair session is live on `notebooks/explore.py`, and CLAUDE.md says cells may only be changed through marimo-pair while it runs, lint fixes included. I don't have a marimo-pair tool here: it isn't in my toolset, it isn't on PATH, and it isn't in the venv. Editing the file directly would break that rule and could clash with the live kernel's copy.

The fix itself is one line. In the `imports` cell (`notebooks/explore.py:9`), sort the two imports so `marimo` comes before `polars`:

```python
@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def imports():
    import marimo as mo
    import polars as pl

    return mo, pl
```

The return line stays as it is. Nothing else needs to change for `ruff check` to pass.

You can make the change in the marimo editor, or give me access to marimo-pair and I'll apply it. If you stop the live session first, I can edit the file directly and rerun `ruff check` to confirm it passes.
